report.title: Decimal amount transfer fails with timeout
report.summary: The transfer page times out when waiting for the amount field to be visible. The test is trying to transfer a decimal amount.
steps_to_reproduce: Open the ParaBank website and navigate to the Transfer Funds page
Enter a decimal amount in the transfer field
Wait for the page to timeout
report.expected: The amount field should be visible and the transfer should be successful
report.actual: Locator.wait_for: Timeout 2000ms exceeded. waiting for locator("#amt") to be visible
evidence: waiting for locator("#amt") to be visible
report.suspected_cause: The browser or application is taking too long to load the amount field
report.next_action: Check the browser and application performance to ensure they are functioning correctly
